title: sarothamnus cantabricus var. dieckii
intro: Sarothamnus cantabricus var. dieckii, commonly known as the Cantabrian broom, is a flowering plant in the pea family (Fabaceae). It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Sarothamnus cantabricus var. dieckii as a medicinal plant.
